main_text.p: sed non funt aut comparént usquam in opere. Nam eo ipso quòd communia funt, negliguntur, teruntur pedibus : curant singuli singularia & particularia, vt vocant. Latinè scripsi, vt Germaniæ vestra aliqua saltem [?]τερψεια[?] renume-rem, qui annos amplius XXV. in ea vi-xerim. Optimo animo cupiui [?]ἀνπολαρ-γῆν[?]. Hæc causa me adduxit vt hoc opu-sculum, qualecunque est, T. C. in-scriberem, & per manus eius offer-rem Germaniæ tuæ. T. C. oro vt hoc meum officium sibi exhibitum in bo-nam partem accipiat, studiumque inter-pretetur bene : Deum vero opt. max. auctorem pacis & charitatis verae, vt benedicens precibus & labori meo, Ec-clesiam suam Germaniamque ipsam ve-strum stabiliat in pace & sanctimonia, & omnium animos, procerum ac po-pularium, in primis T. C. regat in con-siliis, atque ad pacem dirigat constan-tissimè,

page.notes: The Greek words in lines 6 and 8-9 are not fully legible at this scan resolution; their letters are best readings only and are marked [?]. The word "usquam" is read from the context and the printed ligature; the first letters are doubtful. No running head, catchword or margin notes are printed on this page.
